charts.title: TOI-4860 b: orbits around TOI-4860
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4860's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4860 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Almenara et al. 2024 (2024A&A...683A.166A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ALMENARA_ET_AL_2024): P 1.5227591 d

charts.title: TOI-4860 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4860 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (63, 90, 91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 335590096, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
